user.title: XRAS geomagnetic activity
user.description:
Data by the Solar Astronomy Laboratory, IKI RAS (xras.ru).

Enter a region name such as 'moscow' or 'riga' and the code will be resolved automatically, or give the code directly: RAL5 (Moscow), RIK0 (Riga), UP03 (generic UTC+03 zone).
